notes.title: Devlog #9
notes.notes:
Welcome to the next devlog!

As it is easy to guess, you will have to deal with many machines necessary in your daily work in the Car Scrapyard and will undoubtedly make your life easier. This time we will discuss a vehicle that at first glance may seem mainly used in construction, but you will find that not only. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40144722/37d91006c1fab021e16aaf3dc16e6a9597463185.png[/img]

The bulldozer is operated by one person manually and will be helpful, for example, to clean your scrapyard of unprofitable and damaged car parts. You have total freedom to use, segregate all waste correctly, save space for further development and investments, and at the same time care for the environment. Each of you will be able to use different types of vehicles in different ways, but do not forget that you will need cash to develop appropriately. By investing in more machines, you increase your chances of success and make your work faster and more effective.

Let us know which vehicles you think would be useful in Car Scrapyard? We encourage you to discuss this in the comments and on Discord, where you can feel free.

notes.title: Devlog #8
notes.notes:
Hello!

Many pollutants of our planet can occur when working in the Car Scrapyard. One of the biggest problems may be the tires. At some point, it can build up too much and take up a lot of your workspace. Recycling comes to your aid. On the internet market, you can buy the right equipment that will make your job easier. With the specialized truck, you will take an excessive amount of tires. At the same time, save space for new machines and take care of the environment. Keep in mind that you may encounter many factors that will make your work difficult in this industry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40144722/295c8ea7b6a77057f6bbcbeaebbaf05628d8e5b2.png[/img]

Curio:

[i]An estimated 4 billion tires can be found in landfills and stockpiles around the world. In Europe, Japan, and the United States, recyclers recover 85 percent of tires. Around 90 percent of the 246 million scrap tires discarded each year in the United States are consumed in an end-use market. Rubber manufacturers recycle approximately 110 million tires each year.[/i]

Do you have any ideas on how to save space in your Car Scrapyard? Share in the comments section, and don’t forget to visit our social media!


[url=https://discord.gg/V4Ev5Bctpr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40144722/0279c2794cf068cb5823c9d55186e24e838a91e5.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #7
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!

Each person running the scrapyard should remember about the workshop, thanks to which you will have the opportunity to disassemble damaged cars and obtain materials suitable for later sale. Don’t forget that stuff such as engine oil and other fluids can significantly harm the environment. In this profession, you can’t think only about earning money, but also about how to take care of the planet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40144722/60ac7fc0e3b1a8f2969dfa24b81070792903a54c.png[/img]

In the beginning, you have to take a specific car to the workshop and put the vehicle on the elevator. Now the real work begins, dismantle and sell equivalent components. For this you will use a computer, you will be able to put items on the market and sell everything. Getting rich gives you the opportunity to upgrade the entire workplace. Buying new tools will make your work easier, e.g. hacksaw, splitter, squeezer, etc. Additionally, it is worth buying and buying better vehicles, like forklifts, metal crushers, lifts, etc. Also, as you may have noticed, you have the option to change the look and improve the workshop. The only limitation is your budget. Work hard and develop your skills!

Share what you want to hear about in the next devlog. Thank you for today and see you soon. On our Discord, you have the opportunity to share your suggestions.

notes.title: Devlog #6
notes.notes:
Every businessman should have a plan on how he could save some money.  When running your Car Scrapyard, it is worth knowing that recycling aluminum uses less energy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40144722/887311b47f4b30d53c71c5d6cdfb452539418ee7.png[/img]

Recycling aluminum uses 5 percent of the energy that it was used to originally make aluminum. This is possibly the reason why almost half of North America’s aluminum supply comes from recycled aluminum. Recycling aluminum cans is very efficient and cost-effective. Recycling a single aluminum can save enough energy to run a lightbulb for 20 hours or a computer for 3 hours. Despite this positive gain in energy, in 2015, only about 35 % of aluminum cans were recycled, leaving about 2.5 million cans in landfills. 2.5 million cans have the potential energy to give you about 7 million hours of computer power or 2 million hours of light. 

Aluminum is used to make accessories such as pedal covers, decorative strips, door handles, and sometimes as the main building material. Think about it, when you will run your Car Scrapyard. It will help you save money on electricity, and also you can support the environment. 

That’s all for today. Do you have any ideas on how to save money in this industry? Feel free to discuss and we encourage you to check our social media!

notes.title: Devlog #5
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Did you know that by running a scrapyard help environment? Don’t believe me? Scrapping a car saves tons of raw material. Giving a car to the scrapyard instead of the junkyard saves around55 kg of limestone, 635kg of coal, and 1134kg of iron ore; that’s nearly two tonnes of raw material which can be reused! Metal is one of the best recycling things. Reused old metal is saving around 90% of the energy that is needed to produce a new piece of metal. That’s a lot, isn’t it? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40144722/9787cb44dee7eaf83d4fdb4a3f0ca37c58826d0d.png[/img]

What is more, electronic parts also can be recycled! So if you will need to get rid of your old car, sell it in a scrapyard instead of a junkyard. 
I guess that you didn’t expect that running such a place would be eco-friendly, but it is. It’s important to take care of our planet. And it’s important to talk about that even when you make a video game.

notes.title: Devlog #4
notes.notes:
Hi there!

Some people say that the world is small because you can find familiar people, places, rituals etc. around the world. So maybe in some point you can say so here because playing Car Scrapyard Simulator you can see familiar places from other games like Chop Shop Simulator, Outlaw Driver Simulator, Illegal Transporter and Emergency Road Service. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40144722/9beb005aeef7f4487ec5f8e850afbd43145f6428.png[/img]

Everything is connected to each other. You can buy smashed cars from Outlaw Drivers or cars that can’t be saved from Emergency Road Service. You can sell parts to Chop Shops or if you find some gems in wrack you can sell it to gangs which will send to you Illegal Transporter. 

As you may see, setting everything in one universe gives you more opportunities.  What is more you can check if our other games interest you too!

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.notes:
Hello Gamers!

Today I will tell you about growing your scrapyard. 

During your progress, you can buy a bigger store and more ground for your scrapyard where you can put new transport machines and bigger crushers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40144722/5700b7fd4606f6c667415e6664bcac3bea87a676.png[/img]

You will compete with other businesses defined by the reputation that you earn by completing orders as well as their rating (not exceeding the time limit, conformity of goods to the contract, prices compared to the market, etc.). 

You can have 3 types of clients:
Chop shops,
Private drivers,
Service centers. 

All of them have different orders, prices they are willing to pay, and what parts they are more likely to buy. Increasing reputation with each type of customer affects the frequency of purchases and the amount of money they can spend in the store.

That's all for today folks. Don't forget to join our Discord!

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!
Welcome to the second episode of Car Scrapyard Simulator’s devlog. Today, as I said, I will tell you how to earn money in our game. 

You have two ways to earning money :

[list][*] Selling parts.
[*] Selling scrap cubes.[/list]
Let’s start with the last thing. After crushing a wreck in a crusher you get scrap cubes that you need to sell to have more space in your scrapyard. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40144722/3a41d8019a68d412b89a6d9183d31692b523a091.gif[/img]

Selling parts is more demanding. You need to balance your prices between demand and supply. 
You can reduce prices to interest more clients but you have to be careful to not be lossy or you can raise your prices to earn more but in that case, people may not like to buy from you. Clients can give you feedback after which you will know if your prices are relevant. 

On your computer, you will see what you are selling now, what you sold and parts that are not offered for sale yet. 

Your clients can order more than one thing in the same order. After you get a list of products you will have to go to your store to find needed parts and prepare them to send. Once your order is complete and you sell it you get feedback from the client. 

That’s all for today. To the next time!

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.notes:
Hello Gamers!

Welcome to the first Car Scrapyard Simulator’s devlog! We want to bring you closer to the content related to our game. We hope to diversify your waiting time for the premiere with our posts.

Today’s devlog is about machines that are in the Car Scrapyard Simulator. 

One of the machines which you can find there are:

Excavator with grapple,
Excavator with magnet,
Bulldozer,
Crusher.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40144722/530ddfc26bc54e8e69f8d5ec80b63790ddc6c34e.gif[/img]

These first 3 are for transporting your wrecks from the junkyard to your workshop. Each of these machines will require operating manually. The last one is used for crushing bangers after everything valuable and saleable has been taken out. In the beginning, you start with a small crusher and you will need to cut cars using a blowtorch. As you progress you will be able to buy better and bigger machines. 

That’s all for today folks! Next time I will tell you something about earning money.
